cases.name: Helen Jones
cases.about: Helen was born in Ireland according to her obituary. For years she volunteered her time taking care of the elderly. Helen loved gardening, walking along the beach and listening to the sound of the ocean. She was a New England Patriot football fan, loved taking care of her home and cherished times spent with her family.
